outcome: Converting a permanent turns it to its other face under the same rules as transforming.
Converting does not fire triggers for turning a permanent face up or face down.
Converting a permanent that is not double-faced does nothing.
Converting a permanent whose other face is an instant or sorcery does nothing.
A convert instruction from an ability is ignored if the permanent converted or transformed since the ability was put on the stack or created.
A permanent that can't transform also can't convert.
